items.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022
items.q: we had Stan Getz there, we had Diz, we had Woody Shaw, we had Slide Hampton... the band didn’t do anything

ctx.x: Yes I have. It was like how much time did you get to rehearse it?

One day before. One day before. I mean you know why? Because we had Stan Getz there, we had Diz, we had Woody Shaw, we had Slide Hampton. Slide Hampton had three charts over there and they were doing all the soloing but the band didn’t do anything. And so that’s why he came up to me and here I am holding an arrangement that I made for two years and I went, “Do I have something hot for you.” I thought that was funny.
Had you actually heard it played before then?
